Off the Rails#711.dst: Bien sûr, vous le saviez sûrement déjà. Ce que je veux dire, c'est que la nouvelle circulait, alors je parie que son assassin disposait de cette information de l'intérieur.
Off the Rails#711.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#712.src: Truly curious... Who might know about that?
Off the Rails#712.dst: Vraiment curieux... Qui aurait pu le savoir?
Off the Rails#712.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#714.src: Make an accusation at [-{~}, {~}, {~}], or seek more evidence.
Off the Rails#714.dst: Faites une accusation à [-{~}, {~}, {~}], ou cherchez d'autres preuves.

Off the Rails#716.src: Hm. I suppose it makes enough sense. They were awfully quiet when we found the body.
Off the Rails#716.dst: Hm. Ça se tient, j'imagine. Cette personne était bien silencieuse quand on a trouvé le corps.
Off the Rails#716.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#717.src: I dunno, Maury. Something doesn't seem right about this.
Off the Rails#717.dst: J'sais pas, Maury. Y a un truc qui cloche, là.
Off the Rails#717.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#719.src: ...having seen what other parts of Fruma are like, maybe prison would be... an improvement...
Off the Rails#719.dst: ...vu à quoi ressemble le reste de Fruma, la prison serait peut-être... une amélioration...
Off the Rails#719.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#720.src: Works for us, I guess. Just uh, go along with what we tell 'em, alright?
Off the Rails#720.dst: Ça nous va, j'imagine. Euh, contente-toi de confirmer ce qu'on leur dira, d'accord?
Off the Rails#720.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#721.src: Good timin', too. The train's about to arrive in {p}.
Off the Rails#721.dst: Et pile au bon moment. Le train va arriver à {p}.
Off the Rails#721.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#723.src: Yeah, I suppose a university student could get their hands on the weird substances that were involved here. I see it.
Off the Rails#723.dst: Ouais, j'imagine qu'une étudiante pourrait mettre la main sur les substances bizarres utilisées ici. Ça se tient.
Off the Rails#723.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#724.src: But- but why would I kill a general? I don't want to hurt anyone!
Off the Rails#724.dst: Mais- mais pourquoi je tuerais une générale? Je ne veux faire de mal à personne!
Off the Rails#724.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#725.src: Yeah, Maury, I don't really see a motivation here...
Off the Rails#725.dst: Ouais, Maury, je vois pas trop le mobile, là...
Off the Rails#725.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#726.src: Hm... Well, whatever, we never were goin' off of actual guilt, anyway.
Off the Rails#726.dst: Hm... Bah, peu importe, on a jamais cherché le vrai coupable, de toute façon.
Off the Rails#726.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#727.src: Yeah, true, I guess this works.
Off the Rails#727.dst: Ouais, c'est vrai, j'imagine que ça fera l'affaire.
Off the Rails#727.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#728.src: You're under arrest. We're about to arrive in {p}, and we'll be takin' ya straight to the local guard!
Off the Rails#728.dst: T'es en état d'arrestation. On arrive bientôt à {p}, et on t'emmène direct à la garde locale!
Off the Rails#728.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#729.src: The {p} guy? That's who ya think did it?
Off the Rails#729.dst: Le type de {p}? C'est lui que tu soupçonnes?
Off the Rails#729.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#730.src: Yeah, what the heck? He was in the bathroom the whole time. This doesn't make sense...
Off the Rails#730.dst: Ouais, c'est quoi ce délire? Il était aux toilettes tout le temps. Ça n'a pas de sens...
Off the Rails#730.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#732.src: They are right...! It WAS I, Toxic Thistle of the Blossoming Blades, Fruma's deadliest vindicators!
Off the Rails#732.dst: Ils ont raison...! C'ÉTAIT moi, Chardon toxique de la Fleur des Lames, les justiciers les plus redoutables de Fruma!
Off the Rails#732.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#734.src: Behold, lapdogs, the beginning of our glorious revolution!
Off the Rails#734.dst: Contemplez, larbins, le début de notre glorieuse révolution!
Off the Rails#734.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#735.src: Even in arrest, I have won... My brethren who stand against the Queen shall be mobilized by this glorious act of violence...
Off the Rails#735.dst: Même arrêté, j'ai gagné... Mes frères qui s'opposent à la Reine seront galvanisés par ce glorieux acte de violence...
Off the Rails#735.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#736.src: The troubled people of Fruma shall wake to the fact that their rulers are not infallible gods; they shall at last understand that they alone bear the bridles of their own destiny...!
Off the Rails#736.dst: Le peuple accablé de Fruma comprendra que ses dirigeants ne sont pas des dieux infaillibles; il saura enfin qu'il tient seul les rênes de son destin...!
Off the Rails#736.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#738.src: And executed so poetically, too! Think- a titan of House Takshah, slain by merely the poison of House Efelu- even a small Murex Mollusc takes down the mighty rhinoce-
Off the Rails#738.dst: Et exécuté avec tant de poésie! Imaginez- une titane de la Maison Takshah, terrassée par le simple poison de la Maison Efelu- même un petit Murex Mollusc abat le puissant rhinocé-
Off the Rails#738.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#739.src: Well, actually, Murex Molluscs are noted for being quite large for a sn-
Off the Rails#739.dst: Eh bien, en fait, les Murex Molluscs sont réputés assez gros pour un esc-
Off the Rails#739.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#741.src: Before you take me away, you must admit... my exploits are impressive, no?
Off the Rails#741.dst: Avant de m'emmener, avouez-le... mes exploits sont impressionnants, non?
Off the Rails#741.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#742.src: Er... No. I ain't paid enough to care about whatever revolution thing ya were just talkin' about.
Off the Rails#742.dst: Euh... Non. On me paie pas assez pour m'intéresser à ton truc de révolution, là.
Off the Rails#742.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#743.src: Yeah, do you really think any of this is gonna make a difference? Nobody cares about some general. None of this matters.
Off the Rails#743.dst: Ouais, tu crois vraiment que ça va changer quoi que ce soit? Tout le monde se fiche d'une générale. Rien de tout ça ne compte.
Off the Rails#743.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#745.src: What does matter, though, is that you just made our job REAL easy fer us.
Off the Rails#745.dst: Par contre, ce qui compte, c'est que tu viens de nous mâcher VRAIMENT le travail.
Off the Rails#745.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#746.src: C'mon, punk, the train's arrivin' now. We're takin' you to the slammer.
Off the Rails#746.dst: Allez, voyou, le train arrive. On t'emmène au trou.
Off the Rails#746.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#748.src: I guess a guy like him could grow jaded against the system. He's a Roughworker, after all.
Off the Rails#748.dst: J'imagine qu'un type comme lui peut finir aigri contre le système. C'est un gars de Roughworks, après tout.
Off the Rails#748.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#749.src: Yeah, and he's the only guy who could possibly have unlocked the door to the private cabin, so it makes sense, really.
Off the Rails#749.dst: Ouais, et c'est le seul qui pouvait ouvrir la porte du compartiment privé, alors ça se tient, franchement.
Off the Rails#749.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#750.src: But... I would never kill one of the Queen's servants... Or anyone for that matter! Please! Have mercy!
Off the Rails#750.dst: Mais... Je ne tuerais jamais une servante de la Reine... Ni personne d'autre! Je vous en prie! Pitié!
Off the Rails#750.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#751.src: Heh. I don't think ya did it. But I don't care. We never were specifically lookin' to arrest the actual perpetrator.
Off the Rails#751.dst: Héhé. J'pense pas que c'est toi. Mais je m'en fiche. On a jamais cherché à arrêter le vrai coupable.
Off the Rails#751.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#752.src: Yeah, you're believable enough. We'll go with you.
Off the Rails#752.dst: Ouais, t'es assez crédible. On te prend.
Off the Rails#752.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#753.src: Good timin', too! We're about to arrive in {p}.
Off the Rails#753.dst: Et pile au bon moment! On arrive bientôt à {p}.
Off the Rails#753.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#756.src: Yeah, I uh, don' see the angle on this one, pal..
Off the Rails#756.dst: Ouais, je, euh, vois pas trop le rapport pour celui-là, mon pote..
Off the Rails#756.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#757.src: Eh, Roughworkers are pretty disobedient. I think it makes enough sense.
Off the Rails#757.dst: Bah, les gars de Roughworks sont plutôt désobéissants. Ça se tient assez, je trouve.
Off the Rails#757.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#758.src: True... We never were arrestin' based on real guilt anyway, were we? We'll just go with this.
Off the Rails#758.dst: C'est vrai... On a jamais arrêté les gens pour leur vraie culpabilité, hein? On garde celui-là.
Off the Rails#758.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#760.src: Heh. Tell it to Oru, bub.
Off the Rails#760.dst: Héhé. Va raconter ça à Oru, mon gars.
Off the Rails#760.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#761.src: ...Is that something Oru does? Take questio-
Off the Rails#761.dst: ...Oru fait ça? Il écoute les récla-
Off the Rails#761.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#762.src: I DON'T KNOW, Harvin. It just sounded cool to say. And now you've ruined the moment.
Off the Rails#762.dst: J'EN SAIS RIEN, Harvin. Ça sonnait bien, c'est tout. Et là, t'as gâché le moment.
Off the Rails#762.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#763.src: ...Ech. Whatever. Train's about to arrive in {p}, let's get this guy to the slammer.
Off the Rails#763.dst: ...Pff. Peu importe. Le train va arriver à {p}, emmenons ce type au trou.
Off the Rails#763.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#765.src: What? No! It couldn't have been her!
Off the Rails#765.dst: Quoi? Non! Ça ne peut pas être elle!
Off the Rails#765.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#766.src: Uh... Yeah, I don' see how it could've been her, bud.
Off the Rails#766.dst: Euh... Ouais, je vois pas comment ça pourrait être elle, mon pote.
Off the Rails#766.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#767.src: Do we care? We were going to arrest our detective here without evidence, anyway, Maury.
Off the Rails#767.dst: On s'en fiche, non? De toute façon, on allait arrêter notre détective sans preuves, Maury.
Off the Rails#767.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#768.src: I guess yer right, though it might be hard to spin an Aelumian as guilty... They're pretty well-behaved.
Off the Rails#768.dst: T'as raison, j'imagine, même si ce sera dur de faire passer une Aelumienne pour coupable... Ils sont bien élevés.
Off the Rails#768.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#769.src: ...This is ridiculous! You can't do this!
Off the Rails#769.dst: ...C'est ridicule! Vous ne pouvez pas faire ça!
Off the Rails#769.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#770.src: Must I repeat myself? Do ya want to be put down as an accomplice? Quiet, you.
Off the Rails#770.dst: Faut que je me répète? Tu veux être noté comme complice? Toi, tais-toi.
Off the Rails#770.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#771.src: Hey, Maury... What if we arrested HIM instead. It'd be easier to explain, no?
Off the Rails#771.dst: Hé, Maury... Et si on l'arrêtait LUI, plutôt? Ce serait plus facile à expliquer, non?
Off the Rails#771.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#773.src: ...you know what? Yes. Take me instead.
Off the Rails#773.dst: ...vous savez quoi? Oui. Prenez-moi à sa place.
Off the Rails#773.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#775.src: Hands behind yer back, bub, the train's about to arrive in {p}.
Off the Rails#775.dst: Les mains dans le dos, mon gars, le train va arriver à {p}.
Off the Rails#775.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#776.src: Come on, idiot. We're not going to let you accuse US, obviously.
Off the Rails#776.dst: Allez, idiot. On va pas te laisser NOUS accuser, évidemment.
Off the Rails#776.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#777.src: Even if it WAS me, there'd be nothing ya could do about it. We're the ones with power here. Now go and select one of the passengers, come on.
Off the Rails#777.dst: Même si c'ÉTAIT moi, tu pourrais rien y faire. C'est nous qui avons le pouvoir ici. Maintenant, va choisir un des passagers, allez.
Off the Rails#777.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#778.src: ...You mean to suggest she... No, that's just not possible.
Off the Rails#778.dst: ...Tu insinues qu'elle... Non, c'est tout simplement impossible.
Off the Rails#778.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#779.src: Yeah, why would she? She had important business to do...
Off the Rails#779.dst: Ouais, pourquoi elle l'aurait fait? Elle avait des affaires importantes à régler...
Off the Rails#779.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#780.src: Well, Harvin, maybe she got tired of her job? That Majin bossin' her around all the time's gotta get tirin'...
Off the Rails#780.dst: Ben, Harvin, elle en avait peut-être marre de son boulot? Ce Majin qui la commande tout le temps, ça doit être usant...
Off the Rails#780.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#782.src: You know what? Even if she did do it, I don't care; we need someone to blame. Now COME ON! Accuse someone already, preferably alive this time!
Off the Rails#782.dst: Tu sais quoi? Même si c'est elle, je m'en fiche; il nous faut un coupable. Alors ALLEZ! Accuse quelqu'un, et de vivant cette fois, si possible!
Off the Rails#782.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#784.src: That guy we just arrested? He was STACKED! LOADED! We're gonna be vacationing in the {p} with this kind of money, haha!
Off the Rails#784.dst: Ce type qu'on vient d'arrêter? Il était BLINDÉ! PLEIN AUX AS! Avec tout cet argent, on part en vacances à {p}, haha!
Off the Rails#784.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#800.src: Saving up's been a real nightmare, I tell ya. What with the price of rent and food, it's hard to hold onto any money at all!

Off the Rails#800.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#801.src: In order to afford this trip, I've been working overtime every day for the past year, and even eating less just to save on food.
Off the Rails#801.dst: Pour me payer ce voyage, j'ai fait des heures sup' tous les jours depuis un an, et j'ai même moins mangé pour économiser.
Off the Rails#801.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#802.src: I'm glad the nightmare's finally over, though. Once I'm back from this trip, I'm never doing anything like that again!
Off the Rails#802.dst: Mais je suis content que le cauchemar soit enfin fini. Une fois rentré de ce voyage, je ne referai plus jamais un truc pareil!
Off the Rails#802.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#803.src: My job? I work at a tool factory up in the north, we make stuff like nice cutlery for export to the other regions.
Off the Rails#803.dst: Mon boulot? Je bosse dans une usine d'outils dans le nord, on fait de beaux couverts pour l'export vers les autres régions.
Off the Rails#803.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#804.src: Really, I don't get why we can't keep some for ourselves... We're the ones who put in all the work, why do THEY get rewarded for- Agh, whatever.
Off the Rails#804.dst: Franchement, pourquoi on ne peut pas en garder un peu pour nous... C'est nous qui faisons tout le boulot, pourquoi c'est EUX qui sont récompensés pour- Agh, peu importe.
Off the Rails#804.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#805.src: ...Anyway. My factory's let us all take a week off. Usually we only get a day off at this time of year, since the Festival's in town, but...
Off the Rails#805.dst: ...Bref. Mon usine nous a tous donné une semaine de congé. D'habitude, on n'a qu'un jour à cette période de l'année, vu que le Festival est en ville, mais...
Off the Rails#805.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#806.src: It turns out the old steelworks next to the station most of us use to commute to work had a slag beetle infestation, so said station had to be closed. Nasty critters, them, they destroy metals.
Off the Rails#806.dst: Il se trouve que la vieille aciérie près de la gare qu'on prend presque tous pour aller au travail était infestée de scarabées de scories, alors la gare a dû fermer. Sales bestioles, elles détruisent le métal.
Off the Rails#806.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#807.src: Ended up working out for me, though- it's the perfect time for me to finally put my holiday plans into action!
Off the Rails#807.dst: Au final, ça m'arrange- c'est le moment parfait pour enfin concrétiser mes projets de vacances!
Off the Rails#807.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#808.src: Yeah... Working overtime every day does that to ya...
Off the Rails#808.dst: Ouais... Faire des heures sup' tous les jours, ça fait ça...
Off the Rails#808.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#809.src: I've also been expending a lot of energy preparing for my trip... Yawn...
Off the Rails#809.dst: J'ai aussi dépensé beaucoup d'énergie à préparer mon voyage... Bâillement...
Off the Rails#809.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#810.src: Say... I could go for an energy drink. There's a vending machine in this station. Wanna come?
Off the Rails#810.dst: Dis... Je prendrais bien une boisson énergisante. Il y a un distributeur dans cette gare. Tu viens?
Off the Rails#810.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#813.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#814.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#815.src: ...On top of that, I... Honestly, just don't really like Highlanders.
Off the Rails#815.dst: ...En plus, je... Honnêtement, je n'aime pas trop les gens des Hautes-Terres.
Off the Rails#815.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#816.src: ...I mean, seriously! Every time one of them visits the Roughworks, they're always so... inconsiderate. They act like we live in filth... Like they're somehow better than us...
Off the Rails#816.dst: ...Non mais sérieusement! Chaque fois que l'un d'eux visite Roughworks, ils sont toujours si... méprisants. Ils font comme si on vivait dans la crasse... Comme s'ils valaient mieux que nous...
Off the Rails#816.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#817.src: And Majin is the embodiment of that. I mean, he is the Sovereign of the {p}, so, y'know... His drink doesn't really appeal to me.
Off the Rails#817.dst: Et Majin en est l'incarnation. Enfin, c'est le Souverain de {p}, alors, tu vois... Sa boisson ne me tente pas trop.
Off the Rails#817.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#818.src: Oh, yeah. It's ridiculously expensive, too.
Off the Rails#818.dst: Ah, ouais. Et elle est ridiculement chère, en plus.
Off the Rails#818.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#819.src: I have high expectations for {p}. I've heard it's beautiful over there- a couple of my buddies are lucky enough to work at the Auburn Lumbermill.
Off the Rails#819.dst: J'attends beaucoup de {p}. Il paraît que c'est magnifique là-bas- deux de mes potes ont la chance de bosser à la Scierie d'Auburn.
Off the Rails#819.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#820.src: I've never seen what it looks like, personally. The Wall of Xima has made sure of that. But apparently they've got beautiful trees there, trees with golden leaves...
Off the Rails#820.dst: Je n'ai jamais vu à quoi ça ressemble, moi. La Muraille de Xima y a veillé. Mais apparemment, ils ont de beaux arbres là-bas, des arbres aux feuilles dorées...
Off the Rails#820.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#821.src: Sadly, I'm just slightly too late to get to see what the Queen's Festival there is like. I can't imagine it's much different to ours, though.

Off the Rails#821.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#822.src: I bet the people there are lovely, too, just based on what I've seen from their Sovereign. Although, he is apparently a Highlander... Still! Can't be worse than our bunch.
Off the Rails#822.dst: Je parie que les gens là-bas sont adorables aussi, rien qu'à voir leur Souverain. Bon, apparemment, il vient des Hautes-Terres... Quand même! Il peut pas être pire que les nôtres.
Off the Rails#822.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#823.src: Gosh, I'm so excited to get there. This is gonna be the highlight of my life, for certain.
Off the Rails#823.dst: Ça alors, j'ai tellement hâte d'arriver. Ce sera le grand moment de ma vie, c'est sûr.
Off the Rails#823.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#824.src: Oh yeah, right, those people. I've not talked with them, but maybe I should.

Off the Rails#825.src: Just judging from their attire, as well as the odds, they're probably not from around here. Probably tourists.

Off the Rails#826.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#827.src: You want to hear more opinions on the soda from me? Zhirao Sleep's pretty nice, the branding feels tasteful, and just... understanding of us.

Off the Rails#828.src: Majin's is all about HIM. Just HIM. And the soda itself? It's basically just the same drink as Zhirao Sleep but with a bit more flavour. Too much, in my opinion.
Off the Rails#828.dst: Celui de Majin, c'est LUI. Juste LUI. Et le soda en lui-même? C'est presque la même boisson que le Zhirao Sleep, avec un peu plus de goût. Trop, à mon avis.
Off the Rails#828.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#829.src: Pretty much everyone seems to feel this way about it, too, but its advertising is inescapable... It's tiring.

Off the Rails#829.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#836.src: The {p} was... Not quite what I expected. There's quite a unique culture there, though! Did you know they cover everything with gorgeous murals?

Off the Rails#836.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#837.src: It's just a shame I didn't schedule this trip properly... I could have seen the Queen's Festival both here AND there, and now I'll miss both... Oh well...

Off the Rails#931.src: "The Murex Mollusc is a relative of the Gigastropod native to the {p}."
Off the Rails#931.dst: "Le Murex Mollusc est un parent du Gigastropod, originaire de {p}."

Off the Rails#932.src: "Unlike the herbivorous Gigastropod, the Murex Mollusc is a carnivore that hunts for food. From its shell, it can fire toxic darts to aid in this task."
Off the Rails#932.dst: "Contrairement au Gigastropod herbivore, le Murex Mollusc est un carnivore qui chasse. Pour cela, il tire des dards toxiques depuis sa coquille."

Off the Rails#933.src: "Due to the size of some of the {p}' creatures, the toxin in these darts is extremely potent, to the point where it is often lethal to humans."
Off the Rails#933.dst: "Vu la taille de certaines créatures de {p}, la toxine de ces dards est extrêmement puissante, souvent mortelle pour les humains."

Off the Rails#934.src: "This toxin is also known to incapacitate and paralyse those affected by it, a property which has made it desirable to crooks and murderers."
Off the Rails#934.dst: "Cette toxine est aussi connue pour neutraliser et paralyser ses victimes, ce qui la rend prisée des escrocs et des assassins."

Off the Rails#935.src: "However, it has almost never been used in crime, as it is extremely difficult to collect from the Mollusc's fragile darts, which break on impact."
Off the Rails#935.dst: "Elle n'a pourtant presque jamais servi à un crime, car il est très difficile de la recueillir sur les dards fragiles du mollusque, qui se brisent à l'impact."

Off the Rails#936.src: "It is known, however, that the slime trail left behind by Murex Molluscs contains traces of this toxin."
Off the Rails#936.dst: "On sait toutefois que la traînée de bave laissée par les Murex Mollusc contient des traces de cette toxine."

Off the Rails#937.src: "Raids on black markets have found containers of this slime, though the difficulty involved in collecting it has led to a high price."
Off the Rails#937.dst: "Des descentes sur des marchés noirs ont révélé des récipients de cette bave, dont le prix reste élevé tant elle est difficile à récolter."

Off the Rails#938.src: "As such, fortunately, few have chosen to use it to these ends."
Off the Rails#938.dst: "Heureusement, peu de gens ont donc choisi de l'employer à ces fins."

Off the Rails#939.dst: Il y a aussi une illustration de bave de Murex Mollusc. Elle correspond parfaitement à ce que vous avez trouvé sur la lame. C'est forcément ça!
